sentences.text: Christopher Michael Pratt -LRB- born June 21 , 1979 -RRB- is an American actor .

Pratt came to prominence with his television roles , including Bright Abbott in The WB drama series Everwood and Andy Dwyer in the NBC sitcom Parks and Recreation .	The WB	The WB	Everwood	Everwood	Andy Dwyer	Andy Dwyer	Parks and Recreation	Parks and Recreation

His early film career began with supporting roles in such mainstream films as Wanted , Jennifer 's Body , Moneyball , The Five-Year Engagement , Zero Dark Thirty , Delivery Man and Her .
